program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j, !is_c@i & !is_bos@j | !is_bos@j & !is_b@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & is_a@j | !is_bos@j, true)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_c@i | is_c@i, !is_b@i & is_c@i & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !is_c@j | !is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !is_a@j & !is_c@j)
accept = h1_1 & h1_2 & !h2_1

output accept
